en: Late last year, Microsoft's
zh: 去年年底，

en: CEO said something strange.
zh: 微软的 CEO 说了一句奇怪的话。

en: His company may have a bunch of AI chips
zh: 他们可能有一大批 AI 芯片躺在库存里，

en: sitting in inventory — that it can't plug in.
zh: 插不上电。

en: The chips weren't the problem.
zh: 问题不在芯片。

en: The problem, in his words, was power.
zh: 用他的话说，问题在电。

en: So today's question:
zh: 所以今天的问题是：电，

en: will electricity become the ceiling on AI?
zh: 会不会成为 AI 的天花板？

en: My answer is yes. But not in the way you think.
zh: 我的答案是：会。但不是你想的那种方式。

en: Start with the size of it.
zh: 先看规模。

en: In 2024, data centers used about
415 terawatt-hours of electricity.
zh: 全球数据中心用了大约 415 太瓦时的电。

en: That's around one and a half percent
zh: 大约占全世界用电

en: of all the electricity the world uses.
One and a half percent doesn't sound like a crisis.
zh: 1.5%，听起来不像什么危机。

en: But the International Energy Agency expects it to more
zh: 但国际能源署预计，到 2030 年这个数字会翻一倍多，

en: than double by 2030, to around 945 terawatt-hours.
zh: 达到约 945 太瓦时。

en: That's slightly more than all of Japan uses today.
zh: 比整个日本今天的用电量还略多一点。

en: And it's concentrated. The United States alone accounts
zh: 而且非常集中。光美国一家，

en: for about 45 percent of data center electricity.
zh: 就占了全球数据中心用电的约 45%。

en: Through 2030, data centers are expected to drive
zh: 到 2030 年，美国新增的用电需求里，

en: nearly half of America's growth in electricity demand.
zh: 预计将近一半来自数据中心。

en: Here's what most people miss.
zh: 但大多数人没注意到这一点。

en: The world isn't running out of electricity.
zh: 世界不是电不够了，

en: It's running out of time to connect it.
zh: 而是来不及把电接过来。

en: A data center is just a building.
zh: 数据中心只是一栋楼。

en: Feeding it takes a whole chain: power plants,
zh: 给它供电，需要一整条链：

en: transmission lines, transformers.
zh: 发电厂、输电线、变压器。

en: And every link in that chain has a waiting line.
zh: 而这条链上的每一环，都在排队。

en: New transmission lines in advanced
zh: 在发达经济体，

en: economies take four to eight years to build.
zh: 建一条新的输电线要 4 到 8 年。

en: Large power transformers now have lead
zh: 大型变压器的交货期已

en: times of up to four years, and prices have
zh: 经拉长到最多 4 年，

en: jumped roughly 80 percent in five years.
zh: 价格五年里涨了大约 80%。

en: Gas turbines? GE Vernova, one of the biggest makers,
zh: 燃气轮机呢？最大的制造商之一 GE Vernova 去年年底说，

en: said late last year that it was sold out through 2028.
zh: 2028 年以前的产能已经卖光了。

en: The IEA estimates that, unless these
zh: 国际能源署估计，

en: bottlenecks are fixed, around 20 percent of
zh: 如果这些瓶颈解决不了，

en: planned data center projects could be delayed.
zh: 大约 20% 的在建数据中心项目可能延期。

en: Morgan Stanley put a number on the gap: a shortfall of
zh: 摩根士丹利算了一下缺口：到 2028 年，

en: about 32 gigawatts for US data centers through 2028.
zh: 美国数据中心大约缺 32 吉瓦的电。

en: That's roughly a third of what they need.
zh: 差不多是需求的三分之一。

en: When something is scarce, its price tells you.
zh: 一样东西缺不缺，看价格就知道。

en: PJM runs the power grid across all or
zh: PJM 负责管理美国 13 个州（全

en: parts of 13 US states and Washington, D.C.
zh: 部或部分地区）加上华盛顿特区的电网。

en: Every year, it holds an auction
zh: 它每年都会拍卖

en: for future power supply.
zh: 未来的供电能力。

en: For 2024 to 2025, the price was
about 29 dollars per megawatt-day.
zh: 价格大约是每兆瓦每天 29 美元。

en: For 2027 to 2028, it hit 333 dollars,
the maximum the rules allowed.
zh: 价格涨到 333 美元，碰到了规则允许的上限。

en: Analysts estimate that without the cap,
zh: 分析师估计，如果没有上限，

en: it would have been close to 530.
zh: 价格会接近 530 美元。

en: And even at that price, the auction still
zh: 而且就算开出这个价，

en: fell short of its reliability target.
zh: 拍卖还是没凑够保障供电稳定所需的量。

en: The reason? PJM's demand forecast jumped by 5,250 megawatts,
zh: 原因呢？PJM 预测的用电需求一下子多了 5250 兆瓦，

en: almost entirely because of data centers.
zh: 几乎全是因为数据中心。

en: And that cost doesn't stay with tech companies.
zh: 而这笔钱，不只是科技公司在付。

en: In Washington, D.C., one utility's
zh: 在华盛顿特区，

en: residential customers saw bills rise about
zh: 一家电力公司的居民用户从 2025 年 6 月起，

en: 21 dollars a month starting in June 2025,
zh: 电费每月涨了约 21 美元，

en: around 10 of it from these capacity prices.
zh: 其中约 10 美元来自这类容量价格。

en: So the tech giants stopped waiting.
zh: 于是，科技巨头们不等了。

en: Microsoft signed a deal to bring back a reactor
zh: 微软签了协议，

en: at Three Mile Island, which shut down in 2019.
zh: 让三哩岛一座 2019 年就关掉的核反应堆重新启动，

en: It's now expected back online in 2027.
zh: 现在预计 2027 年恢复发电。

en: Others are skipping the grid entirely.
zh: 还有人干脆绕开电网。

en: One analysis counted 59 US data center projects
zh: 一份分析统计，美国有 59 个数据中心项目计划自建现场发电，

en: planning about 90 gigawatts of their own on-site power.
zh: 总共约 90 吉瓦。

en: That's more than a quarter of all planned
zh: 这超过了全美规划中数据

en: data center capacity in the country.
zh: 中心总容量的四分之一。

en: And 92 percent of those projects were
zh: 而其中 92% 的项目，

en: announced since the start of 2025.
zh: 都是 2025 年以后才宣布的。

en: It got strange. Crusoe, a company that builds AI data centers,
zh: 事情开始变得离奇。AI 数据中心建造商 Crusoe，

en: ordered 29 gas turbines from Boom Supersonic,
zh: 向 Boom Supersonic 订了 29 台燃气轮机，

en: a startup best known for designing supersonic jets.
zh: 而这家公司最出名的是设计超音速客机。

en: Then, just last month, Crusoe walked
zh: 结果就在上个月，

en: away from that deal and turned to
zh: Crusoe 放弃了这笔订单，

en: established suppliers like GE Vernova.
zh: 转向 GE Vernova 这样的老牌供应商。

en: When time is the bottleneck,
zh: 当时间就是瓶颈，没被验证过的机器，

en: an untested machine is a risk few can afford.
zh: 是很少有人敢冒的险。

en: Now flip the map.
zh: 现在，把地图翻过来。

en: China generates more than twice as
zh: 中国的发电量，

en: much electricity as the United States.
zh: 是美国的两倍多。

en: In 2025 alone, it added more than 430
zh: 光是 2025 年一年，

en: gigawatts of wind and solar capacity.
zh: 中国就新增了超过 430 吉瓦的风电和光伏装机。

en: BloombergNEF expects China to add more
zh: 彭博新能源财经预计，

en: than six times as much generation capacity
zh: 未来五年，

en: as the US over the next five years.
zh: 中国新增的发电装机将是美国的六倍多。

en: One business school researcher put it simply:
zh: 一位商学院的研究者说得很直白：

en: the US has the chips and is short on power.
zh: 美国有芯片、缺电；

en: China has the power and is short on chips.
zh: 中国有电、缺芯片。

en: So electricity isn't one ceiling.
zh: 所以电不是一块天花板。

en: It's a different ceiling, depending on where you stand.
zh: 站在哪里，天花板就不一样。

en: So here's my call.
zh: 所以，我的判断是：

en: Electricity won't stop AI.
zh: 电挡不住 AI，

en: Too much money is chasing this problem for that.
zh: 追着这个问题砸的钱太多了。

en: But for the next few years, power will
zh: 但未来几年，电会决定三件事：

en: decide three things: how fast AI grows,
zh: AI 长得多快、

en: where it gets built, and who wins.
zh: 建在哪里，以及谁会赢。

en: The winners won't just be the ones with the best models.
zh: 赢家不只是模型最好的那家，

en: They'll be the ones who locked in power early.
zh: 而是最早锁定电力的那家。

en: I'd go further: by the end of this decade,
zh: 我甚至觉得：到这个十年结束时，

en: a guaranteed grid connection may be worth
zh: 一个有保障的电网接口，

en: more than the chips you plug into it.
zh: 可能比插在上面的芯片还值钱。

en: What does this mean for you?
zh: 这和你有什么关系？

en: If you live where data centers are booming,
zh: 如果你住在数据中心扎堆的地方，

en: part of AI's bill may already be on your electricity bill.
zh: AI 的一部分账单，可能已经算进你的电费里了。

en: And next time someone says AI is limited by chips,
zh: 下次再有人说 AI 卡在芯片上，

en: remember Microsoft's problem.
zh: 想想微软的问题：

en: The chips were there. The power wasn't.
zh: 芯片有了，电没有。

en: So which do you think runs out first: chips,
zh: 那你觉得，芯片和电，

en: or electricity? Tell me in the comments.
zh: 哪个会先不够用？评论区告诉我。
